name: table
postprocess: cwebp -q 82; the PNG originals (the SC-60 plate and the SC-78 re-light) stay local in src/
prompt: Tilt-shift photograph, soft morning light from a window at the left, shallow depth of field. A pale wooden table. At the right of the frame a person's hand holds a modern smartphone upright, its screen a plain matte black rectangle facing the camera squarely, filling about a quarter of the frame height. Spread across the table in front of the phone, a handmade miniature diorama of an Indian snack trade: a tiny corrugated godown warehouse with its shutter rolled up and stacked brown cartons inside, a lane of three tiny colourful kirana shops with rows of snack packets hanging at their fronts, a tiny white delivery van, a tiny modern wholesale warehouse with a small blue truck at its bay, a small community kitchen with a blue awning, and in the far corner a tiny fenced dump yard with its gate closed. A steel tumbler of chai steams beside the diorama. One thin softly glowing green painted path runs along the table from the godown to the kirana lane and on to the wholesale warehouse. Warm sand, terracotta and sage-green palette. No lettering, no words or numbers on anything, no logos, no faces.
use: smartclearance.com, the scene where the agents work the batch (SC-60, round 2 option 2: In focus), by day
attempts: one; the phone screen came out plain black as asked, the hand natural, the six places readable and apart

relit.mode: edit_image: the approved day plate (design3/site/assets/plates/table.webp, SC-60) as the condition image, so the geometry holds for the posts measured on it
relit.prompt: Keep everything exactly as it is: the same hand and phone with its plain matte black screen, the same miniature buildings in the same places, the same white van, blue truck, fence and chai tumbler, the same framing. Change only the light and the colour: late-morning sun comes low through the window at the left and rakes across the table, casting long soft shadows from every building and carton; the wooden table turns a warm honey oak with visible grain; the white wall, the curtain and the window are toned down to warm cream with no glare and no haze; the colours are deeper and richer, terracotta, sage green and brown, with darker shadows under the buildings and inside the godown; the thin painted green path stays and glows a little. A richer, warmer, higher-contrast tilt-shift photograph. No lettering, no words or numbers, no logos, no faces.
relit.why: by day the scene read too white (SC-78, part 2); the plate was re-lit as an edit of itself, so the posts measured on it still hold
